### Figure 1
Maps of cumulative impact and change in cumulative impact
```{r}

library(paletteer)
library(png)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)
library(countrycode)

library(showtext)
font_add(family = 'bentonbold', 
         regular = here('font/BentonSans', 
                        'BentonSans Condensed Bold', 
                        'BentonSans Condensed Bold.otf'))
font_add(family = 'benton', 
         regular = here('font/BentonSans',

```

Get land boundaries

```{r}

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
# Define the Mollweide projection string
moll_crs <- "+proj=moll"

# Reproject the world data to Mollweide
world_moll <- st_transform(world, crs = moll_crs)

```



# Plot S1 Map of decreased areas
```{r}

ssp2_med <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp245_medium-term.tif")- 
            rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp245_current.tif") 

decrease <- ifel(ssp2_med <= 0, 1, NA)
ocean <- rast(here("_spatial/ocean_area_mol.tif"))
area <- decrease*ocean
global(area, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)/global(ocean, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)

decrease_df <- as.data.frame(decrease, xy=TRUE)
ocean2 <- ifel(ocean>0, 1, NA)
# Remove borders and labels
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', bty = 'n')
plot(ocean2, col="lightblue", axes=FALSE, box=FALSE, legend=FALSE )
points(decrease_df$x, decrease_df$y, col="red", pch=16, cex=0.2)


# determine what is happening in these regions
pressures <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/", full=TRUE, pattern="ssp245") # created below
pressure_stack <- rast(pressures)
names(pressure_stack) <- basename(sources(pressure_stack))
tmp <- zonal(pressure_stack, decrease, fun="mean", na.rm=TRUE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=-sum,
               names_to="variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  separate(col=variable, into=c("pressure", "scenario", "timeframe"),
           sep="_")



ssp5_med <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_medium-term.tif")- 
            rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_current.tif") 

decrease <- ifel(ssp5_med <= 0, 1, NA)

decrease_df <- as.data.frame(decrease, xy=TRUE)
# Remove borders and labels
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', bty = 'n')
plot(ocean2, col="lightblue", axes=FALSE, box=FALSE, legend=FALSE )
points(decrease_df$x, decrease_df$y, col="red", pch=16, cex=0.2)

```

# Plot S2
Some figures made in impacts.Rmd for SSP5-8.5 scenarios. They are in impact/figs/cumulative

### Figure 1
Maps of cumulative impact and change in cumulative impact

Get land boundaries

```{r}

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
# Define the Mollweide projection string
moll_crs <- "+proj=moll"

# Reproject the world data to Mollweide
world_moll <- st_transform(world, crs = moll_crs)

```

histogram and statistics for latitudinal patterns
```{r}

tmp <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE, pattern = "current|medium-term")
stack <- rast(tmp)
new_names <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(tmp))
names(stack) <- new_names

global_df <- as.data.frame(stack, xy=TRUE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ssp"),  
    names_to = "scenario",      
    values_to = "value"         
  ) %>%
  group_by(y, scenario) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            sum_impact = sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(avg_impact = sum_impact/n) %>%
  dplyr::select(y, scenario, avg_impact) 


plot_data <- global_df %>%
  filter(scenario %in% c("ssp585_current", "ssp585_medium-term"))

hist <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = y, y = avg_impact, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_area(
    data = filter(plot_data, scenario == "ssp585_current"),
    aes(x = y, y = avg_impact, fill = "ssp585_current"),
    alpha = 0.5, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_area(
    data = filter(plot_data, scenario == "ssp585_medium-term"),
    aes(x = y, y = avg_impact, fill = "ssp585_medium-term"),
    alpha = 0.5, color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("ssp585_current" = "blue", "ssp585_medium-term" = "red"),
    guide = "none"  # Remove legend
  ) +
  theme_void() +  # Removes all background, grids, and axis lines
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),    # Remove title
    axis.title = element_blank(),    # Remove axis titles
    axis.text = element_blank(),     # Remove axis text
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),    # Remove axis ticks
    panel.grid = element_blank(),    # Remove grid lines
    panel.border = element_blank()   # Remove border
  )

ggsave(hist, filename=here("impact/figs/latitudinal_impacts_ssp585.png"), width=5.5, height =2, units = c("in"))

```


Hotspot statistics

```{r}

## find the highest spots
list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)

current <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_current.tif")
max(current$sum)

```


Global plot of hotspots
```{r}

ssp2_change <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_medium-term.tif") -
               rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_current.tif")
ssp2_change_high_quant <-global(ssp2_change, fun = quantile, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_change_high <- ifel(ssp2_change >= ssp2_change_high_quant, 1, 0)
ssp2_change_low_quant <-global(ssp2_change, fun = quantile, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_change_low <- ifel(ssp2_change <= ssp2_change_low_quant, 1, 0)

ssp2_current <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_current.tif")
ssp2_current_high_quant <-global(ssp2_current, fun = quantile, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_current_high <- ifel(ssp2_current >= ssp2_current_high_quant, 1, 0)
ssp2_current_low_quant <-global(ssp2_current, fun = quantile, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_current_low <- ifel(ssp2_current <= ssp2_current_low_quant, 1, 0)

# category 1: current low and stable
cat1 <- ssp2_current_low + ssp2_change_low
cat1 <- ifel(cat1 == 2, 3, NA)
plot(cat1, col="#26547C")

# category 2: current high and stable
cat2 <- ssp2_current_high + ssp2_change_low
cat2 <- ifel(cat2 == 2, 4, NA)
plot(cat2, col="#FDCFF3", add=TRUE)

# category 3: current low and fast increase
cat3 <- ssp2_current_low + ssp2_change_high
cat3 <- ifel(cat3 == 2, 4, NA)
plot(cat3, col="#FFD166", add=TRUE)


# category 4: current high and fast increase
cat4 <- ssp2_current_high + ssp2_change_high
cat4 <- ifel(cat4 == 2, 3, NA)
plot(cat4, col="#EF476F", add=TRUE)


png(here("impact/figs/hotspots_ssp585.png"), width = 2000, height = 1500, res = 300)

plot(st_geometry(world_moll), col="gray80", border="gray85")
plot(cat1, col="#26547C", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)
plot(cat2, col="#FDCFF3", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)
plot(cat3, col="#FFD166", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)
plot(cat4, col="#EF476F", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)

dev.off()

```



## Figure S4: coastal vs ocean
```{r}

cumulative <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)
cum_stack <- rast(cumulative)
source_info <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(sources(cum_stack)))
names(cum_stack) <- source_info

offshore_pressures <- cum_stack*offshore

offshore_points <- data.frame(offshore_pressures)
offshore_points$region <- "offshore"

coastal_pressures <- cum_stack*coast

coast_points <- data.frame(coastal_pressures)
coast_points$region <- "coastal"

point_data <- rbind(coast_points, offshore_points[sample(nrow(offshore_points), dim(coast_points)[1]), ])

colnames(point_data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(point_data))


point_data_long <- point_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ssp"),       # Columns to reshape
    names_to = c("scenario", "time_period"),  # New column names
    names_sep = "_",                 # Separator used in column names
    values_to = "value"              # Name of the values column
  )

point_data_plot <- filter(point_data_long, scenario == "ssp585", time_period %in% c("current", "medium-term"))

# Calculate the overall range of 'value' to set consistent axes
range(point_data_long$value, na.rm = TRUE)


cum <- ggplot(point_data_plot, aes(y = region, x = value, fill = region)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  xlim(0, 2) + 
  facet_wrap(~ time_period, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("offshore" = "#3CA8BCFF", "coastal" = "#EF8A0CFF")) +
    labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1, 2)) +  # Customize x-axis values
  theme(text = element_text(family = 'benton', size=37.5),
        #axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
 #   axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # Remove y-axis labels
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), # Remove y-axis ticks
    strip.text = element_blank()    # Remove facet plot titles
  )
print(cum)
ggsave(cum, filename=here("impact/figs/coastal_vs_offshore_cumulative_impact_ssp585.png"), width=4.5, height =1.75, units = c("in"), dpi=300)



```



Plot each pressure by region
```{r}

list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/")

pressures <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/", full=TRUE, pattern="ssp585")
pressure_stack <- rast(pressures)
source_info <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(sources(pressure_stack)))
names(pressure_stack) <- source_info


offshore2 <- ifel(offshore>=1, 2, 0)
offshore2 <- ifel(is.na(offshore2), 0, offshore2)
coast2 <- ifel(is.na(coast), 0, coast)
habitats <- offshore2 + coast2
habitats <- ifel(habitats == 0, NA, habitats)

coast_area <- global(coast, "sum", na.rm=TRUE) %>% pull()
offshore_area <- global(offshore, "sum", na.rm=TRUE) %>% pull()

area_df <- data.frame(region = c("coastal", "offshore"),
                      area = c(coast_area, offshore_area))

  # Compute the average pressure impact for each region
  zonal_sum <- zonal(pressure_stack, habitats, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)


avg_pressure_impacts <- zonal_sum %>%
 pivot_longer(cols=-ocean_area_mol, names_to = "pressure_impact", values_to="value") %>%
separate(
    col = pressure_impact,
    into = c("pressure", "scenario", "time_period"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(region = ifelse(ocean_area_mol == 1, "coastal", "offshore")) %>%
  mutate(pressure = gsub("-", " ", pressure)) %>%
  left_join(area_df, by="region") %>%
  mutate(pressure_impact = value/area) %>%
  dplyr::select(pressure, scenario, time_period, region, pressure_impact)

# Calculate average impact for each pressure
average_impacts <- avg_pressure_impacts %>%
  group_by(pressure) %>%
  summarize(avg_impact = mean(pressure_impact, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(avg_impact)


# Prepare data
df <- avg_pressure_impacts %>%
  mutate(
    pressure = factor(pressure, levels = average_impacts$pressure),
    region = factor(region), 
    time_period = factor(time_period, levels = c("current", "medium-term"))
  )

# Reshape data to wide format
df_wide <- df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(pressure, region),
    names_from = time_period,
    values_from = pressure_impact
  ) %>%
  arrange(pressure)

# Create combined factor and adjust positions
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    pressure_position = as.numeric(factor(pressure, levels = levels(df$pressure))),
    y_position = pressure_position + ifelse(region == "coastal", -0.1, 0.1),
    delta = `medium-term` - current,
    offset = delta * 0.05,  # Adjust this fraction as needed
    x_start = current + sign(delta) * offset,
    x_end = `medium-term` - sign(delta) * offset
  )


# Create the plot
coast_compare <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = df_wide,
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_position,
      yend = y_position,
      color = region
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_wide,
    aes(x = current, y = y_position, shape = "Current", color = region),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_wide,
    aes(x = `medium-term`, y = y_position, shape = "Medium-Term", color = region),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = unique(df_wide$pressure_position),
    labels = levels(df$pressure)
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "",  # Legend title
    values = c("Current" = 16, "Medium-Term" = 17),
    labels = c("Current" = "current", "Medium-Term" = "future")  # Customized labels
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c("offshore" = "#3CA8BCFF", "coastal" = "#EF8A0CFF")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Impact",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = 'benton', size = 37.5),
        #axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"  )
coast_compare
ggsave(coast_compare, filename ="impact/figs/coastal_vs_offshore_pressure_impact_585.png", width=5, height =3.5, units = c("in"))


```


## Figure S5 Habitat comparison

```{r}

avg_hab_impact_tmp <- read_csv(here::here('impact/data/avg_hab_impact_tmp2.csv'))

## make data wide
avg_hab_impact <- avg_hab_impact_tmp %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = scen_time,
    values_from = avg_impact,
    values_fill = list(avg_impact = 0)) %>%
  mutate(ssp245_change = `ssp245_medium-term`-ssp245_current,
         ssp585_change = `ssp585_medium-term`-ssp585_current)

filter(avg_hab_impact, ssp585_change<0)
# Step 1: Summarize the data to get total values for each pressure within each habitat
pressure_change_order <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  group_by(pressure) %>%
  summarize(total_value = sum(`ssp585_change`), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(total_value) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure)))


habitat_change_order <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarize(total_value = sum(`ssp585_medium-term`), .groups='drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat)))


 # Step 2: Get plot data and reorder the 'pressure' factor levels based on the total_value
current_plot_data <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  dplyr::select(habitat, pressure, impact = ssp585_current, color) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure_change_order$pressure))) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat_change_order$habitat))) %>%
  calc_start_end(group = 'habitat')

current_totals <- current_plot_data %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarize(current_tot = sum(impact))

# get the change
# Step 2b: Get plot data and reorder the 'pressure' factor levels based on the total_value
change_plot_data <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  dplyr::select(habitat, pressure, impact =`ssp585_change`, color) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure_change_order$pressure))) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat_change_order$habitat))) %>%
  calc_start_end(group = 'habitat') %>%
  ### to emphasize negative scores on plot
  # mutate(start = ifelse(start < 0, start*50, start)) %>%
  left_join(current_totals, by = c('habitat')) %>%
  mutate(end = end + current_tot, start = start + current_tot)

```

```{r}

# Step 3: Plot the future impacts data

current_plots_bars <- ggplot() +
  ### adjust position_nudge and linewidth to get the desired look
  geom_segment(data = change_plot_data, position = position_nudge(y = .03),
               aes(x = start, xend = end, y = habitat, color = pressure), linewidth = 4.3) +
  ### adjust position_nudge and linewidth to get the desired look
  geom_segment(data = current_plot_data, position = position_nudge(y = -.15),
               aes(x = start, xend = end, y = habitat, color = pressure), linewidth = 2.3) +
  labs(color = NULL) +  # removes the legend title
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(current_plot_data$color, current_plot_data$pressure)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = 'black') +
  ylab("Habitat") + 
  xlab("Cumulative impact") +
  theme(text = element_text(family = 'benton', size = 37.5),
        #axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black")
    #,
    #legend.position = "none"  
    )
ggsave(here("impact/figs/habitat_impact_current_barplot_ssp585.png"), plot = current_plots_bars, 
       width = 7, height = 4, units = 'in', dpi = 300)

#knitr::include_graphics(here("impact/figs/habitat_impact_current_barplot.png"))
```

## Figure S6: Ecoregion and pressure


```{r}
## make data wide

pressure_georgn <- read_csv(here('impact/int/pressure_georgn.csv'))

avg_georgn_impact <- pressure_georgn %>%
  pivot_wider(

    values_from = avg_impact,
    values_fill = list(avg_impact = 0)) %>%
  mutate(ssp245_change = `ssp245_medium-term`-ssp245_current,
         ssp585_change = `ssp585_medium-term`-ssp585_current)


# Step 1: Summarize the data to get total values for each pressure within each geosubrgn
pressure_change_order <- avg_georgn_impact %>%
  group_by(pressure) %>%
  summarize(total_value = sum(`ssp585_change`), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(total_value) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure)))

  ### to emphasize negative scores on plot

  left_join(current_totals, by = c('georgn')) %>%
  mutate(end = end + current_tot, start = start + current_tot)
```
